summary: Retest of GYMBOSS_VVO Milestone 1 after iteration_1 fixes. Backend: full pytest suite 33/33 PASSED (cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v -p no:randomly), including the previously failing TestBruteForce::test_lockout_via_public_ingress. Independently reproduced lockout through the PUBLIC URL: 6 consecutive wrong passwords on one identifier returned [401,401,401,401,401,429]. Auth-playbook checks verified: bcrypt hashes are $2b$12$ for both demo owner and super admin, login sets httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None access_token and refresh_token cookies, cookie-only GET /auth/me and /dashboard/summary return 200, password_reset_tokens store only sha256 token_hash (no raw token), CORS-with-credentials asserted at app level. Dashboard summary for demo returns today_collection=6000, active_members=22 (IST day bounds now used). Frontend: all 8 claimed fixes verified plus the full regression happy path — landing + WhatsApp glyph FAB, fresh 3-step registration (10-day trial, empty-state KPIs, onboarding checklist), demo login, KPI grid (8 cards, ₹ formatted) + 7 secondary metrics + 10 recent transaction rows, outlet switcher refetch (All ₹6,000 -> Indiranagar ₹4,500), theme dark/light/system with gb-theme persistence across reload, onboarding dismiss persists after reload, logout -> /login and protected-route redirect, super admin GymBoss -> /superadmin, mobile 390px drawer with -mobile scoped testids and working navigation. Zero React console errors (no BrowserRouter render-phase warning). Cleanup done: lockout probe rows removed, QA-created org deleted, demo org onboarding.dismissed restored to false. Seeded Iron Paradise Fitness data untouched.

minor.issue: Successful login clears only the ip:identifier bucket (delete_many({'identifier': lock_key})). The new per-identifier cap (10 rows in 15 min, matched on the 'email' field) still counts failed rows recorded under other proxy IPs, so a legitimate user who just authenticated can still be 429'd by residual rows. Suggest also deleting by {'email': ident.lower()} on success.

Threshold is now checked before insert (good), but the counter is still keyed on email only with no IP dimension, so 5 anonymous requests can block password resets for a known address for 15 minutes. Low severity DoS; consider IP+email keying.
Still loads every member document with find(member_q).to_list(10000) (line 463) and aggregates in Python. Correct now, but move to an aggregation pipeline before larger tenants land in Milestone 2.

issues: While summary is loading, the KPI area shows skeletons but the Recent Transactions card immediately renders the 'No transactions yet' empty state (transactions.length===0 before fetch resolves), producing a misleading flash for accounts that do have payments. Gate transactions-empty on a loaded flag instead of length only.

/app/profile has no dedicated route; it resolves via the catch-all <Route path=':module'> to the generic ComingSoon page. Functionally fine as a placeholder (verified coming-soon-page renders), just noting there is no explicit profile route.

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor): on successful login also clear login_attempts by identifier/email so residual cross-IP rows cannot 429 a legitimate user.
OPTIONAL (minor): add an IP dimension to the forgot-password rate limiter.
OPTIONAL (minor): gate the Recent Transactions empty state on a loaded flag to avoid the 'No transactions yet' flash during load.
OPTIONAL (perf): replace the 10k-member in-memory scan in /api/dashboard/summary with an aggregation pipeline before Milestone 2.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login(): X-Forwarded-For left-most parsing + per-identifier cap now works end-to-end through the ingress (verified 429 on the 6th attempt via the public URL). Only gap left is the asymmetric reset on success (lock_key-only delete).
server.py dashboard_summary(): IST day bounds correctly implemented (IST tz + now_utc().astimezone(IST).date()); the full-collection member scan remains the main scalability concern.
AppLayout.jsx: sidebarContent(scope) now suffixes every testid with -desktop/-mobile; verified zero duplicate/unscoped ids in the DOM at both 1920px and 390px.
Login.jsx/Register.jsx: redirects now use <Navigate replace /> — no setState-in-render console error observed across login, registration and logout flows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows; 8/8 claimed fixes verified

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_1 issues are fixed and verified; no HIGH/CRITICAL defects remain. Correct testids (iteration_1 report had some wrong guesses): login inputs are login-identifier / login-password / login-submit-button; register uses register-next-1, register-next-2, register-finish-button (step1 = name+email, step2 = phone+password+confirm, step3 = gym+outlet+city); dashboard primary KPIs are kpi-today-collection etc. and secondary are metric-active-members / metric-total-members; theme trigger is topbar-theme-toggle in the app shell and auth-theme-toggle on auth pages (localStorage key gb-theme); forgot page uses forgot-email / forgot-submit-button / forgot-success. rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — the iteration_1 HIGH lockout defect is resolved. Root cause was request.client.host resolving to rotating ingress pod IPs; login() now takes the left-most X-Forwarded-For entry and additionally caps failures per identifier (10/15min), which restores the 401x5 -> 429 behaviour through the public URL.
